translations.10: We eat lunch with the team members
translations.12: On the second day, we spend the whole day in the field.
translations.13: We observe the unloading process while wearing safety shoes.
translations.14: We do not speak to the drivers who are working first.
translations.15: The experience report is submitted to the team leader for approval.
translations.16: Once confirmed, it will be forwarded to Manager Byun Jun-ho.
translations.18: New hires at MoaLogis go through a task list called 'Launchpad' in the first week.
translations.19: Launchpad 1 is logging into the wiki and joining the company messenger.
translations.20: Company-wide announcements and casual chat take place in the 'Hearth' channel.
translations.22: Step 2 is taking the fleet allocation system Pathfinder training.
translations.23: You will create a day's worth of fleet allocation plan yourself using Pathfinder.
translations.24: Do not upload practice screens to Hearth.
translations.25: The report doesn't have to be long.
translations.26: After finishing all the stepping stones, you will enter practical work starting from the second week.
translations.27: The first practical work will be receiving a code review with 엄서진.
translations.28: Code review results will be shared in the campfire team channel.
translations.29: If you have any questions, feel free to ask Manager Byun Junho.
